text:
Maya: quick question — can we implement a staged toggle that gates expansion by telemetry signal instead of just time/pct? thinking: start 0.1% -> wait for errors & latency signal -> bump to 1% -> then 10% if healthy :thinking_face:
Jon: yes, we talked about telemetry-gated rollouts in the RFC but never implemented the gating automation. main gap is the signal contract (which metrics, windows, thresholds). also sampling impact on dashboards.
Rachel: fwiw we should keep deterministic bucketing (user.id mod N) so we can replay traces. random sampling messes with observability.
Marco: +1 deterministic. also need a sampling multiplier for telemetry ingestion so we can increase sampling when investigating and not blow up costs. e.g. normal samp=0.01, debug samp=0.1 for cohorts.
Maya: rough config idea (pseudo):
```yaml
staged_toggle:
  name: enable_new_routing
  phases:
    - pct: 0.001
      rule: "user.id % 10000 < 10"
      telemetry_gate:
        metric: request_error_rate
        eval_window_minutes: 15
        threshold: 0.005
    - pct: 0.01
      rule: "user.id % 10000 < 100"
    - pct: 0.1
      rule: "user.id % 10000 < 1000"
  fallback: original_route
  shadow: true
```
Jon: config looks good. two debates: 1) where to store the gate evaluation (control plane vs runtime agent) and 2) how to surface gating status in console.
Rachel: runtime agent evaluation is faster for latency SLOs but harder to audit. control plane evaluation gives a single source of truth and easier tracing. maybe hybrid: runtime emits metrics, control plane subscribes and decides, then pushes phase advance.
Marco: console UX: show small green/yellow/red pill for each phase, plus recent metric sparkline + last evaluation time. also allow manual override with required justification + audit log.
Maya: +1 on manual override with approval step. need a dry-run API for owners so they can preview cohorts without flipping prod.
Rachel: technical note — ETag-based optimistic updates are key for avoiding racey rollouts. we had issues when two folks bumped percentages simultaneously. also need a 'live-diff' in console to preview changes before commit.
Jon: ops concern: what if gating misses a slow drift (e.g., p95 increases slowly)? suggest dual-gate: immediate error_rate threshold AND trend-based guard (pct change over 1h).
Maya: good call. add trend_guard: pct_change_threshold and window.
Marco: regarding telemetry sampling multiplier -> add hooks so infra can temporarily tag specific trace ids for full retention. low-overhead marker that forces retention downstream.
deploy-bot: dry-run start: staged_toggle.enable_new_routing phase=1 samples=1000 (shadow:true) user=maya
Maya: deployed dry-run for 1k samples. I'll watch the dashboard for 30m and flag if anything weird.
Rachel: if everyone ok, can we add a lightweight Playbook step to auto-rollback to previous phase if error_rate spikes > 2x baseline within 10m? keeps human in loop but automatic protection.
Jon: agreed. also include notification to #incidents and owner paging when auto-rollback triggers.
Maya: thanks team — I'll open a tiny RFC with config schema + console mockups and link the dry-run logs here. :thumbsup:
